name: Ubuntu VPS Multi-Version
author: noniko9901@gmail.com
description: Ubuntu 20.04, 22.04, 24.04 or 26.04 in PRoot with root SSH on the primary allocation port.

variables.name: Ubuntu version
variables.description: Select the Ubuntu root filesystem installed at first start.

variables.name: SSH authentication
variables.description: Select password, key, or both. Both requires both variables.

variables.name: SSH password
variables.description: Strong root SSH password. Required for password/both mode.

variables.name: SSH public key
variables.description: Full public key line. Required for key/both mode.
